label: Samba (3D: a dancer, your words on a board beside them, a mystery box)

preset.title: Samba
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and watch the dance.
body: Someone learned the samba just to say this properly.
Happy birthday. You make everything more fun.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: A dancer dances the samba while a board with these words rises on a stand beside them. Then a mystery box drops in and the letter floats out of it.

rows.label: Words on the board
rows.note: About 40 letters at most. It is painted in capitals on up to three lines; longer words get smaller. Left empty, the board says "Congratulations!".
